name: Space Cowboys
bio: Space Cowboys is a French board-game studio created in 2014 within the Asmodee group by Marc Nunès, Philippe Mouret and Croc, later joined by Cyril Demaegd and Sébastien Pauchon. It is known for narrative games such as T.I.M.E Stories and the Unlock! escape-room card series, for which it publishes free print-and-play demos.
